subject: Initiating vendor security questionnaire and confirming evidence owners
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initiating vendor security questionnaire and confirming evidence owners

Hi Emily — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our SDR/AE call: 

Summary of what we covered:
- High-level product deployment: Redwood hosted inference + dedicated option for regulated workloads.
- Compliance needs you flagged: HIPAA (primary), GDPR applicability for EU users, SOC 2 report for vendor risk.
- Questionnaire preference: you said you wanted a CAIQ/OSS or SIG-based intake + a short custom dataflow diagram.

What we'll do on our side:
1) Start a SIG-prefill to speed your review (attached: SIG-prefill-template.xlsx).
2) Share a targeted evidence ask list for SOC 2 / encryption / BAAs.
3) Propose a short kickoff (30m) to confirm scope and evidence owners so we avoid back-and-forth.

Clarifying questions for you (so we scope the right form):
- Confirmed: is Nimbus Health storing PHI in the app database and object store? (HIPAA scope)
- Do you require a BAA from Redwood? If yes, will legal need to review before questionnaire work starts?
- Which form do you prefer us to prefill: SIG Lite, full SIG/CAIQ, or your custom questionnaire?
- Who should be the technical evidence owner on your side (name + email)?
- Any specific controls you want prioritized (KMS/HSM, audit logs retention, data at rest/encryption details)?

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- If you confirm scope today, we can deliver a prefill + evidence ask in 2 business days and schedule a kickoff for Mon 31 Aug (10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET).

Attachments: SIG-prefill-template.xlsx (prefill workbook)

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the prefill and loop in Marissa (security lead) for technical follow-ups.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@nimbushealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Alan Park <alan@securify.io>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initiating vendor security questionnaire and confirming evidence owners

Thanks, Aditya — good call. A few quick clarifications from Nimbus: 

- PHI scope: yes — Nimbus stores PHI (patient demographic + diagnostic metadata) in our primary DB and S3-backed object store.
- BAA: we do require a BAA; legal will want to review but we can proceed with the questionnaire concurrently.
- Form preference: given our external audit process, CAIQ + a short SIG supplement would be ideal (CAIQ for cloud mapping, SIG for control evidence). If you have to choose one to start, CAIQ-first is fine.
- Evidence priority: SOC 2 report (most recent), encryption at rest keys (do you support KMS/HSM?), logging/retention for audit trails, and BAA language examples.

I attached a simple dataflow diagram we sketched during the call (Nimbus-software-dataflow-v2.pdf) — it should help narrow which controls apply to your hosted infra.

Technical owner on our side: Alan Park (alan@securify.io) — he’s handling evidence collection and will be the day-to-day contact. I’m cc’ing him here.

Timeline: aiming to complete intake + initial evidence delivery within 2 weeks if we can keep to a 1–2 touch cadence. Kickoff on Mon 31 Aug 10:00am PT works for us.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Zhao
Head of Product, Nimbus Health
emily.zhao@nimbushealth.com | (617) 555-2468

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alan Park <alan@securify.io>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 17:39:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initiating vendor security questionnaire and confirming evidence owners

On Tue, Aug 25, 2026 at 5:03 PM Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@nimbushealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Aditya — good call. A few quick clarifications from Nimbus: 
> 
> - PHI scope: yes — Nimbus stores PHI (patient demographic + diagnostic metadata) in our primary DB and S3-backed object store.
> - BAA: we do require a BAA; legal will want to review but we can proceed with the questionnaire concurrently.
> 
Appreciate the quick confirmation — noting the HIPAA/PHI scope and preference for CAIQ-first. Given PHI is in your app and object store, we’ll treat this as full HIPAA scope (so SIG-lite may not be sufficient alone). A couple more specifics so Marissa (cc’d) and our security team can prepare the right evidence set: 

Quick follow-up questions (short answers appreciated):
1) Which cloud region hosts the PHI for Nimbus (us-east-1, us-west-2, etc.)?
2) Do you have a BAA template you prefer we review, or should we send our standard BAA draft?
3) Data retention policy for PHI (e.g., 7 years / 365 days)?
4) Any cross-border transfers (EU patients) we need to account for (GDPR)?
5) Do you require HSM-backed KMS for key storage or is KMS with customer-managed keys acceptable?

I’ve attached a short instructions doc for our prefill process (redwood-sig-prefill-instructions.pdf) and a compact evidence-ask CSV we’ll use to track ownership. If we can get answers to the five quick Qs and confirm Alan as tech owner, we’ll prefill the CAIQ and surface the prioritized evidence we need (SOC 2 report, BAA, encryption architecture diagrams).

Proposed kickoff: Mon 31 Aug 2026, 10:00am PT — I’ll send a calendar invite if that works.

Best,
Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@nimbushealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Alan Park <alan@securify.io>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 18:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initiating vendor security questionnaire and confirming evidence owners

Thanks — quick confirmations below and attaching our NDA (signed) for your records.

- Cloud region: us-east-1 for PHI (primary).
- BAA: we have a standard BAA; I’ve asked legal to share a copy to Alan and me by EOD. In the meantime we can look at your draft if you prefer.
- Retention: default is 7 years for PHI (policy enforced in DB retention).
- GDPR: yes — a subset of patients are EU-based; please include GDPR controls in the CAIQ prefill.
- KMS: we prefer HSM-backed customer-managed keys for PHI at rest; if Redwood can support that we’ll prioritize it in the evidence ask.

Alan will own day-to-day evidence collection (alan@securify.io). Kickoff Mon 31 Aug 10:00am PT confirmed — we’ll join.

Attachments: signed-nda.pdf

See you Monday — Emily
